claim_scope: Codex/Luna visible-development comparison only; not pooled with canonical Claude-Code A/B cells or held-out evidence.
objective: Test whether bounded checkpointed research plus exact demand paging matches or beats comparable frozen upstream Mike under one fixed Codex Sol judge while using fewer provider-reported total tokens.

supersedes.checkpoint_paged_v1_v2_v3: Excluded before scoring for missing handoff/phase validity, unbounded research, or an over-cap mounted result, as recorded in the prior registrations.

checkpoint_paged_v4.reason: CoC and tax were clean and efficient, but indenture requested a ninth initial evidence batch after eight checkpoints. The generation therefore failed the bounded-initial-research gate and its otherwise valid cells remain diagnostics only.

v5_general_correction: Initial research is capped at four successful evidence checkpoints for every task. The fourth checkpoint prompt preserves residual uncertainty and requires readiness for drafting.
The host overrides a fourth continue_research=true to false and blocks further initial research calls; it directs the agent to open drafting.
The cap does not close research permanently. A draft/check pass can still gather a concrete missing fact, checkpoint it, remount the accreted exact union, and redraft.
Checkpoint responses/events, benchmark surface, handoff, config, metrics, and fail-closed validation record the checkpoint number, requested/effective continuation, cap, and cap-reached status.

held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB development tasks only

run_policy.trace_gate: Before scoring, inspect exact task/source/code/prompt/tool/config hashes, default tier, requested/effective checkpoint decisions, handoff/working-set receipts, page grants and sizes, phase behavior, cache/tokens/latency, and evaluator-readable artifacts.
run_policy.fix_policy: Only a request-independent shared defect permits another generation; no task-specific prompt, router, rubric, or benchmark hint is allowed.
run_policy.scoring_exclusions: Full-rehydration and checkpoint generations v1-v4 are diagnostics only.

upstream.required_match: Exact task/source bytes, codex:gpt-5.6-luna, high effort, actual default tier, one replicate, and fixed Sol judging.

acceptance_gate.accuracy: Candidate aggregate must match or exceed comparable upstream; an unexplained task regression fails a tie.
acceptance_gate.tokens: Candidate aggregate must use fewer provider-reported total tokens than upstream and, absent an explained accuracy gain, fewer per task.
acceptance_gate.structure: Every requested DOCX must be authored in drafting, non-empty, evaluator-readable, and have an exact SHA-256 receipt.
acceptance_gate.checkpoint: Every evidence delta is reviewed and checkpointed; at most four initial checkpoints; targeted post-draft research remains checkpointed before redraft.
acceptance_gate.paging: Exact union remains host-side; checkpoint <=12000, hot packet/page <=24000; only exact Grep grants and same-line continuations open mounted Read; first fresh reads remain visible and same-context duplicates are bounded.
acceptance_gate.fail_closed: Tier, structure, receipts, fingerprints, caps, or comparator mismatch blocks scoring or the architectural claim.

dynamic_fingerprint_policy: Each result config must preserve exact system-prompt/tool-schema SHA-256 sets and the combined run fingerprint from the real sealed context manifest; random uploaded ids make these dynamic hashes unknowable until launch.
